title: Iranian forces arrest five Kurdish men in Marivan
content:
Iranian forces have arrested five Kurdish citizens from the village of Sardosh, Marivan, Kurdistan Province—Shirzad Abdi, Azad Norouzi, Zaniar Gaderi, Zaniar Tavana, and Pouya Kakeh Mohammadi—without warrants, transferring them to an undisclosed location.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that in the early hours of Saturday, August 29, dozens of security personnel with multiple vehicles raided the village of Sardosh in Marivan and detained the five citizens without presenting a judicial warrant.


Despite the families’ attempts to obtain information about their loved ones, the security and judicial authorities have refused to respond or provide any explanation regarding their situation.


No information is available regarding the reasons for the arrests or the charges brought against them.

author: David Venn
title: Aqqusariaq Recovery Centre’s new executive director prepares for opening day
content:
Annie Aningmiuq’s experience as an Inuk in the south is helping her imagine what might make future clients at Iqaluit’s Aqqusariaq Recovery Centre feel at home.


Take food, for example.


When Aningmiuq, the recently minted executive director of the healing centre, and her son lived down south, family members would bring her country food. If she went without it for a couple of weeks, her appetite for other foods would be lacking and she’d lose her energy.


At the same time, she said, if she ate maktaaq or tuktu by herself, it wouldn’t quite feel right. She needed her loved ones on the side.


“That aspect alone is magical,” she said in an interview about the power of making connections over a traditional meal.


That’s why regularly offering inuksiut, which roughly translates to “food for the soul,” to clients is one of the many plans that Aningmiuq says she looks forward to implementing when the healing centre opens.


There is still no clear timeline for when that will be. When construction on the $87-million centre began in August 2023, Nunavut’s Health Department said it

expected

 the building to be complete by December 2025.


“The last update we had was that it was going to be done by the end of this month and then they just came back saying they need more time but they didn’t have a specific date,” Aningmiuq said.


The healing centre is in the final stages of construction, said Chelsea Halvorson, spokesperson for the Department of Health, Friday in an email.


“Following substantial completion and final GN preparations, it will

transition

 to NTI and the Inuit-led not-for-profit who will determine when the facility is ready to welcome clients,” Halvorson said.


In the meantime, Aningmiuq is busy charting out programming, planning community visits, writing outreach materials and recruiting staff, which includes Inuit nurses and social workers who currently work in the south.


The availability of Inuit health staff shows some things are changing, Aningmiuq noted.


“When I was growing up, I didn’t know of one single Inuk nurse,” Aningmiuq said. “Now there’s multiple.”


Staff will have access to 25 housing units in a new complex downtown, she said, adding that “it’s going to open up a lot of opportunities for Inuit.”


Aqqusariaq translates to “a trail you go through to reach your destination.”


Located north of Toonik Pond, the healing centre will include facilities for both inpatient and outpatient care, including a daycare, traditional ceremony areas and two wings dedicated to trauma and addictions recovery, according to architectural firm Stantec’s website.


It will have a beading room, a sewing room, and an area for butchering, Aningmiuq said, adding there will be “elders-in-residence” as well as therapists, and an area for youth.


She said the centre will also have rooms with cribs so that, for example, if a mother wants to access Aqqusariaq’s services, she doesn’t have to leave her child behind.


“It’s very much Inuit-centred and focused when it comes to wellness and how Inuit need specific things that maybe aren’t offered in a southern institution,” Aningmiuq said.


Services will be available to Nunavut Inuit throughout the country, and Aningmiuq is looking forward to welcoming them.


“It’s going to take some time for people to want to take the step,” she said.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "We're Not Going Back": Ron Daniels on the Legacy of 1972 Gary Convention & 1963 March on Washington
content:
As Gary, Indiana, recovers from flooding and a two-week power outage, we also speak with Ron Daniels, president of the Institute of the Black World 21st Century, who discusses the city’s history as a site of Black struggle and organizing. In 1972, the city hosted the National Black Political Convention, which brought together thousands of activists to plan for increasing African American political power. Attendees included Coretta Scott King, Betty Shabazz, Jesse Jackson, Bobby Seale, Louis Farrakhan, Shirley Chisholm, Harry Belafonte and Amiri Baraka.


“It was one of the great gatherings in the history of Black people in this country,” says Daniels, who calls the current backlash to racial progress “the dying gasp of a system that needs a major overhaul.”

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Left Behind and Overlooked": Indiana Energy Company Left Majority-Black Gary Powerless for Weeks
content:
Thousands of residents recently spent two weeks without power in Gary, Indiana, following a storm that ripped through the majority-Black city. The blackout ground the city to a halt, trapping residents in their apartments, forcing the closure of many businesses and leading to fuel shortages at gas stations. Officials in Indiana estimate the storm might have caused up to $5 billion in damage in Gary and other communities.


“We’re still in the recovery phase, as we speak,” says Gary Mayor Eddie Melton, who underscores that “hardening the infrastructure” should be a priority for the

NIPSCO

 utility company. “We’ve never seen wind this strong before. … They need to ensure that the utility grid system is going to sustain that type of wind.”

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: False drowning report triggers overnight search in Inukjuak
content:
A false report that a man had drowned in Inukjuak on Monday night triggered an overnight search while the community’s emergency services were already stretched to capacity, Mayor Bobby Epoo says.


A report that came in around 7:45 p.m. claimed a man had jumped into the river and drowned, he said.


The community launched a search-and-rescue operation, with a rescue boat deployed on the river and community members searching the coastline. It

 continued until about 1:30 a.m. Tuesday, Aug. 25, before resuming around 6 a.m., he said.


“On that specific night, the entire medical staff in the clinic and first responders were called in with other types of emergencies like accidents, pneumonia and conjugal violence,” Epoo said Friday in an interview.


A couple of hours into the morning search, community members told Epoo and municipal manager Aliva Tookalook that the alleged victim was spotted walking from where the incident had been reported. 


They later verified that the man was safe and called off the search, Epoo said.


In an Aug. 25 Facebook post, Epoo said that the village would pursue charges over the false report, citing the danger involved and the heavy drain on municipal emergency resources.


In an email to Nunatsiaq News, Nunavik Police Service public relations manager Julie Berthold said the initial information provided to first responders and to the municipality was “inaccurate and misleading.”


She said officers walked along the river and visited the alleged victim’s relatives and friends until he was found safe.


Epoo said one officer took a boat across the river to search the rocky and slippery shoreline, which posed a risk because the officer was wearing 70 pounds of equipment.


Four search-and-rescue members were on a boat. Others drove their personal boats, with two or three people in each.


There were also “maybe 20 other people” walking along the river’s edge and a licensed local drone operator, Epoo said.


Intentionally misleading police, including by making a false complaint to cause prejudice against someone, can lead to a charge of public mischief, Berthold said in the email.


Police are investigating, Berthold said, although no arrests have been made.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: The Real Reason There's a Munitions Shortage? Too Many Wars & a Dysfunctional Pentagon: William Hartung
content:
Top U.S. military leaders have reportedly advised Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth against extending the war in Iran because ongoing operations in the Middle East have degraded the Pentagon’s ability to confront threats elsewhere. According to

The Washington Post

, the warnings appeared in a classified assessment for Hegseth prepared by the heads of the Army, Navy and Air Force and the four-star commanders overseeing U.S. operations throughout Europe, Asia and Latin America. This comes after multiple reports have revealed the U.S. is facing a critical munitions shortage, having used up much of its global stockpile of expensive missile systems during the war against Iran.


“The Pentagon is completely dysfunctional when it comes to fighting this kind of war,” says defense analyst William Hartung, principal adviser at the Project on Government Oversight. He says the U.S. policy establishment and the defense industry are less interested in effectiveness than in running a “money-making machine.”

title: Podcast: Militarism and the Art of Slander
content:
By Marc Eliot Stein, World BEYOND War, August 31, 2026


From Seattle Opera’s “Barber of Seville”: David Gould and Roger Howell as Don Basilio and Don Bartolo


The following is a complete transcript of episode 87 of the World BEYOND War podcast. NOTE: Our monthly podcast usually features interviews, which we don’t transcribe since automatic transcription might not accurately reflect what our guests say. This month’s podcast is my own personal statement, a reflection of various topics ranging from the revolutionary legacy of classic opera to the histories of Haiti, Venezuela and Cuba to USA apartheid and USA’s war with Iran, concluding with a message about what it feels like for a middle-class urban progressive to be constantly accused of being privileged and out of touch.


Disclaimer #1: As always, this podcast contains only my own words and opinions.


Disclaimer #2: It’s unfortunate that I claim in this episode to have gained some ability to speak Italian and French by singing opera, because upon listening back to this recording I realize I badly mangled many Italian and French names here. I do think I am able to achieve some level of good pronunciation when slowly singing rehearsed parts, but my accuracy obviously drops once I get on a roll and start talking fast in English. Apologies!


Militarism and the Art of Slander


Welcome to episode 87 of the World BEYOND War podcast. I’m Marc Eliot Stein, technology director of World Beyond War, speaking from the Lanape lands of Brooklyn, New York. It’s August 2026 and the first thing I want to do today is express our love for the people of Nepal and China and Tibet, as we all try to grasp the enormity of the tragedy from the mudslide that began with a glacial collapse. This seems to be a disaster caused by climate change, and the world better wake the hell up because our planet is at a boiling point right now in more ways than one. Last month’s episode was about Asia, and our hearts go out to the people of Tibet and Nepal. 


I’ve got a lot to talk about today and I hope you don’t mind if I seem to ramble from one topic to another, because I actually do have a particular plan and purpose here today, and I hope it will all come together in the end.


I mentioned a few times on this podcast that when I’m not busy being a peace activist or a software developer, my favorite thing to do is sing opera. It’s been a thrill to me to sing ensemble with a couple of different community theater opera companies in New York City and Long Island. I’m a self-trained musician and hardly an exceptional singer, but I do always work hard in rehearsal and take my parts seriously, and that’s really what it takes to make community theater work.


Opera is only a recent obsession in my life, and what originally got me involved in opera is basically the same impulse that got me involved in peace activism: my desire to learn and understand world history. Reading a lot of books and trying to analyze and comprehend patterns in world history has been my lifelong pursuit and it has also been really my gateway to pacifism – and what I mean by this is that anybody who observes many historical and current wars and genocides and violent subjugations of peoples over the sweep of history will start to see a simple and obvious repeating pattern, which is that the decision to go to war is always a bad decision, rather like the decision of a habitual drunk driver to have a drink. Wars are sold as a method to solve conflicts, but this is a dangerously false promise, because in the real world wars never solve problems, but rather create new problems that lead to worse conflicts. Militarism also always leads to a degradation of government and a hollowing out of democracy, as war profiteers use their stolen gains to influence corrupt politicians to enable the continuance of their crimes.


The biggest pattern of all is that wars are self-replicators. A war may finally wrench to its painful end, when enough misery has been suffered on all sides, but time always reveals that wars of the past plant seeds for the wars of the future. No war ever really ends, and we can look at World War One, World War Two and today’s looming World War Three as evidence of this. It turns out that fear and racism and trauma from violence is passed down from generation to generation intact, with no reduction in intensity. These are the patterns I’ve learned from a lifelong study of world history.

title: "Catastrophe of Unimaginable Proportions": Nepal Flood Death Toll Tops 900; Near 5,000 Still Missing
content:
More than 900 people in Nepal are confirmed dead after a massive wall of water, mud and debris crashed through a Himalayan river valley on the border with Tibet. More than 4,200 people are missing in Nepal and hundreds more in Tibet. Families are searching hospitals for loved ones, and crews have buried hundreds of unidentified bodies in shallow graves. Rescue efforts are also underway for more than 900 hydropower workers, believed to be trapped in more than a dozen underground tunnels blocked by debris. The cause of the flash flooding is believed to have been the collapse of a glacier in the mountains, leading a wave of water, rocks and debris to carve its way through the valley.


“This is a catastrophe of unimaginable proportions,” says journalist Kunda Dixit, speaking to

Democracy Now!

 from the Nepalese capital of Kathmandu.


“We used to say that the glaciers are melting in the Himalaya. Now it seems like the mountains are cracking up,” says Dixit. “This has sort of redefined what global warming and climate change is doing, not just to Nepal and the Himalaya, but to the planet.”

title: Armed Israeli Settlers Kidnap British Activist
content:
Armed Israeli settlers kidnapped a British activist in the illegally occupied West Bank on Saturday, before locking him in a shed and then handing him over to police, his lawyer said. 


Finn Joughin, 22, was trying to prevent settlers from dismantling a fence in the Palestinian village of Umm al-Khair when two men dragged him away,

video of the incident

He was handed over to police but not charged with a crime, and was due to be deported on Sunday.   


“Without any hearing, the police have decided to move him to deportation, which just shows that this entire case has been political in the first place,” Joughin’s lawyer, Inbar Shaked Vard,

told the Associated Press

She added: “He merely stood by the fence that the settlers were trying to dismantle, in order to prevent them from doing so. He was then kidnapped by armed men, who were not in uniform and therefore did not have authority to do so.”


The UK Foreign Office said it had raised the case with Israeli authorities. 


The incident happened amid a spike in violence by settlers and security forces against foreign observers in the West Bank over the weekend.

author: Alice Maciel
title: Mansões, carros de luxo, viagens: a vida de Eduardo Bolsonaro e Figueiredo nos EUA
content:
Mansões, carros de luxo, viagens, restaurantes caros. Enquanto fazem lobby para tentar enfraquecer o governo brasileiro e o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) junto ao governo de Donald Trump, o ex-deputado federal Eduardo Bolsonaro e o influenciador Paulo Figueiredo mantêm um alto padrão de vida nos Estados Unidos (EUA).


Ambos já afirmaram enfrentar dificuldades financeiras devido ao que chamam de “perseguição política”. No entanto, um levantamento da

Agência Pública

 e do

ICL Notícias

 revela um cenário diferente. Além de viverem em casas milionárias, no último ano os dois adquiriram carros caros, têm frequentado restaurantes sofisticados, mantêm os filhos em escolas particulares e acumularam uma extensa agenda de viagens.


Eduardo Bolsonaro e Paulo Figueiredo foram centrais na articulação para impor tarifas contra o Brasil e retaliações contra ministros do Supremo. Desde 2025, eles participaram de dezenas de reuniões com deputados republicanos e membros do governo dos EUA pedindo intervenções em resposta à condenação do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro por tentativa de golpe de Estado em 8 de janeiro de 2023.


Em maio de 2025, três meses após se mudar para o Texas e anunciar que viveria uma espécie de “autoexílio”, Eduardo Bolsonaro comprou um carro novo. Não exatamente um modelo econômico para atravessar tempos difíceis. Ele adquiriu um GMC Acadia Elevation 2025 preto, um SUV de três fileiras de assentos, avaliado em cerca de 43,8 mil dólares nos EUA, o que equivale a aproximadamente R$ 226 mil.


Os registros de gastos associados à família Bolsonaro nos EUA mostram que, desde a mudança para o país, em fevereiro do ano passado, o padrão de vida não parece ter encolhido, nem mesmo após o STF determinar o bloqueio dos bens de Eduardo Bolsonaro e de sua esposa, Heloísa Bolsonaro, em julho de 2025. Eduardo ainda perdeu o salário que recebia como deputado federal em dezembro, quando seu mandato foi cassado por faltas, e, desde 2015, não recebe salário como escrivão da PF, de onde a corporação

recomendou

 sua demissão por abandono do cargo.


Ao chegar aos EUA, o ex-deputado escolheu Arlington, no Texas, onde já havia mantido uma empresa entre 2023 e 2024. A residência alugada estava longe de ter as dimensões de um refúgio improvisado. Tinha pouco mais de 300 metros quadrados, quatro quartos e quatro banheiros, com valor de mercado estimado em 707,7 mil dólares (cerca de R$ 3,6 milhões). O valor da locação anunciado em sites imobiliários, quando eles alugaram a casa, era de 4,5 mil dólares,  aproximadamente R$ 23,3 mil na cotação atual.


Em maio de 2025, Jair Bolsonaro chegou a

transferir

 R$ 2 milhões ao filho. “Botei dinheiro na mão dele, dinheiro limpo, legal, Pix”,

afirmou

 o ex-presidente.


Dias depois, Eduardo chegou a reclamar para o pai, em mensagens trocadas por Whatsapp, que estava “se fodendo” nos EUA. Ao reclamar de uma entrevista em que Jair dizia que o filho era imaturo, Eduardo reclamou que, ao jogar ele para baixo, o ex-presidente o estaria condenando a passar o “resto da vida nessa porra aqui”. “VTNC seu ingrato do caralho!”, escreveu.


A situação parece ter melhorado desde então. Pouco mais de um ano depois, em maio de 2026, a família trocou Arlington por um endereço ainda mais valorizado, em Southlake, uma das cidades mais ricas do Texas, onde a renda familiar média é de 250 mil dólares – três vezes maior do que em Arlington, por exemplo. Eduardo, a esposa e os dois filhos moram atualmente em uma casa que oferece “uma vida de resort”, conforme

revelou

 o

The Intercept Brasil

.


Avaliada em 1,22 milhão de dólares, cerca de R$ 6 milhões, a mansão foi anunciada para aluguel por aproximadamente 5,9 mil dólares (em torno de R$ 30 mil mensais), segundo anúncios imobiliários que permaneceram ativos até fevereiro deste ano. O imóvel tem 424 metros quadrados de área construída, em um terreno de 1.366 metros quadrados, quatro quartos e piscina, além de acesso a um clube com quadras de tênis e a uma lagoa.


A filha mais velha do casal Bolsonaro, de cinco anos, foi matriculada numa escola cristã a cerca de 15 minutos de casa, com custo anual de 18 mil dólares (R$ 93,4 mil), conforme divulgado no site da escola.


Eduardo nega ter usado parte da verba do filme Dark Horse para custear sua vida nos EUA. O filme foi financiado com cerca de R$ 61 milhões do banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, por meio do Fundo Havengate. O negócio veio à tona após reportagem do

Intercept Brasil.

title: Örhan: All institutions must unite against drug addiction
content:
Concerns over drug use and substance addiction are growing in the Sur district of Diyarbakır (Amed). Children and young people in particular are increasingly being targeted by drug networks, prompting public concern as drug use becomes more visible across neighbourhoods.


Research conducted across the city, along with accounts from healthcare workers, indicates that the age at which children are first exposed to substance use has fallen to increasingly younger ages. There are growing calls for comprehensive public and preventive policies to curb drug use in the district and protect young people.


Sur Municipality Co-Mayor Adnan Örhan spoke to ANF about drug use and addiction in the district.


An open wound in society


Örhan said substance addiction had become one of society’s “open wounds,” adding that since taking office, the municipality had identified the drawing of children and young people into networks of addiction as one of the most serious problems facing the district. 


He said: “Since we took office more than two and a half years ago, one of the most serious problems we have observed and witnessed in society is, unfortunately, young people and children being lured into the trap of substance addiction. There are underlying reasons for this. It is not something that emerged on its own. After trustees were appointed in 2016, virtually all public spaces were shut down. Society as a whole was effectively denied room to breathe.


When spaces for children, women and young people were completely closed down, and society was suffocated under an oppressive form of governance, unfortunately, some malicious gangs, groups and individuals sought to draw young people and children into drug networks.”


 


Families cannot go out in the evenings


Örhan said substance addiction could not be treated solely as a health issue and stressed the importance of properly lighting the streets of Sur and making them safer. 


Örhan said: “When we go out into the streets, we are confronted with the cries of families. Mothers, women and children tell us about this time and again. They say, ‘We cannot go out into the streets after a certain hour in the evening.’ In Sur in particular, the situation has become extremely serious.


For nearly two years, we have held talks with Dicle Electricity Distribution Company (DEDAŞ) over street lighting in Sur. We raised the issue at a meeting attended by officials from the governor’s office and DEDAŞ, but they told us that the problem had still not been resolved. Street lighting is of vital importance for Sur.


Families, women and children who cannot go outside after dark are unfortunately forced to leave the streets to people using drugs. Extremely disturbing incidents are taking place here. We see that this, in turn, brings prostitution, harassment and rape, as well as the proliferation of gangs.”


Substance addiction, gangs and poverty are interconnected


Örhan said that tackling only the consequences of substance addiction would not be enough. He said: “When you suffocate a society and deny it social and economic opportunities, people with malicious intentions find many ways and methods to deceive young people and children and draw them into these networks. Unfortunately, this has become much more prevalent in poorer neighbourhoods.


Drug networks are able to operate more freely, particularly in neighbourhoods facing economic hardship. You can see this with your own eyes. To prevent the problem from worsening, the central government needs to develop social and economic policies.”


We are working to free Amed from substance addiction


Örhan said that local administrations were carrying out a range of initiatives to combat addiction, adding that, together with the work of the Şiyar Be Platform over the past year, they were pursuing a collective effort to prevent addiction in Diyarbakır.


Örhan also said: “We are carrying out serious efforts to free Amed from substance addiction as much as possible and to protect our young people from it. Rehabilitation centers have been opened, as well as counseling centers for substance addiction. We have colleagues working in these centers. Public meetings are held at certain times. We are working to raise awareness among people and encourage them to support these efforts. We believe that we will make significant progress in this regard.”


Gang activity threatens public safety

content:
Bursa — Bursa’nın Orhaneli ilçesinde düğünde ikram edilen yemeği yiyen 84 kişi gıda zehirlenmesi şüphesiyle hastaneye başvurdu. Olayla ilgili inceleme başlatıldı.

title: Erdoğan imzaladı: Bakanlık, BTK ve DHMİ'ye yeni atamalar
content:
Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın imzasıyla Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı, Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İletişim Kurulu (BTK) ile Devlet Hava Meydanları İşletmesi (DHMİ) Genel Müdürlüğüne yapılan atamalar Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı.

31 Ağustos tarihli Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanan kararlara göre, Türkiye Yazma Eserler Kurumu Başkanı Coşkun Yılmaz, Kültür ve Turizm Bakan Yardımcılığına atandı. Yılmaz'ın ataması, 3 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kararnamesinin 2 ve 3'üncü maddeleri kapsamında yapıldı.

Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İletişim Kurulu Başkanlığına Mehmet Koçyiğit getirildi.

Kurul üyeliklerine ise Kültür ve Turizm Bakan Yardımcısı Batuhan Mumcu, DHMİ Genel Müdürü ve Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enes Çakmak ile Celalettin Dinçer ve Liman Pekker atandı.

Atamaların, 2813 sayılı Kanunun 8'inci maddesi ile 3 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kararnamesinin 2, 3 ve 7'nci maddeleri kapsamında gerçekleştirildiği belirtildi.

Bir diğer kararla Devlet Hava Meydanları İşletmesi Genel Müdürlüğü ve Yönetim Kurulu Başkanlığına Fatih Çakmak getirildi.

DHMİ Genel Müdür Yardımcısı ve Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi olarak görev yapan Çakmak'ın ataması, 233 sayılı Kanun Hükmünde Kararnamenin 6'ncı maddesi ile 3 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kararnamesinin 2 ve 3'üncü maddeleri uyarınca yapıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: “Marx era satanista”: la broma macabra de tener a un ignorante como presidente
content:
Camaradas:


Javier Milei ha dicho que el marxismo «implica el exterminio físico de individuos» y que «el programa de Dios trae abundancia y armonía; la elección no es política, es moral». Sería una broma de mal gusto si no fuese terriblemente serio que semejante personaje gobierne un país. Lo dice el mismo individuo al que se acusa de dejar a enfermos de cáncer sin medicamentos y a ancianos con pensiones insuficientes. Ahí está la verdadera moral de Milei: la del sálvese quien pueda, la del desprecio absoluto por quien sufre.


Porque satánico, si hay que utilizar su propio vocabulario religioso, es quien no siente ninguna empatía por el dolor ajeno y considera terrorismo la justicia social. Un hombre que ha hablado públicamente de su consumo de medicación psiquiátrica y que ha protagonizado declaraciones extravagantes sobre sus perros, mientras pretende presentarse como referente moral, está muy lejos de cualquier prédica de humanidad.


Vivimos tiempos oscuros en los que el neofascismo y el capitalismo salvaje avanzan sin freno a escala global. Nos venden recetas mágicas disfrazadas de rebeldía, pero la realidad golpea siempre a los mismos: a la clase trabajadora. El ejemplo más brutal de esta barbarie lo tenemos hoy en la Argentina de Milei.


A Milei le encanta presentarse como adalid de la libertad, «anarcocapitalista» que venía a destruir los privilegios de la casta. Esa fue, desde el primer día, la gran estafa. Quienes defendemos a los de abajo sabemos perfectamente que, para el neoliberalismo más extremo, la palabra «libertad» solo significa una cosa: la libertad de los poderosos para explotar sin límite y el sálvese quien pueda para todos los demás.


La realidad demuestra que la «casta» contra la que Milei decía luchar nunca fueron los grandes empresarios ni los fondos buitre. La verdadera casta que su gobierno ha decidido aplastar es la clase trabajadora con derechos. Quienes sufren sus políticas no son los millonarios: son los obreros que pierden su empleo, los pensionistas desamparados y las familias que tienen dificultades para llegar a fin de mes mientras ven deteriorarse los servicios públicos. Milei solo gusta a quien tiene la barriga llena.


El verdadero peligro de figuras mesiánicas como esta es que no surgen de la nada. Son también el resultado del fracaso de una izquierda institucional que se alejó de la calle, que hizo política de salón y que contribuyó a dejar espacio a la extrema derecha. Cuando el pueblo se siente desprotegido y carece de una organización fuerte, es más fácil engañarlo con discursos de odio y promesas vacías.


Argentina es hoy una lección dolorosa para toda la clase obrera mundial: nos muestra de forma dramática qué ocurre cuando un pueblo pierde la conciencia de clase. Sin conciencia colectiva ni organización sindical, es mucho más fácil que los trabajadores sean dominados y que sus derechos sean recortados.


Milei representa, a juicio de quienes sufrimos sus políticas, el capitalismo en una de sus formas más deshumanizadas: una máquina de generar desigualdad que, de seguir así, puede arrastrar al país a un profundo abismo social. Dolarización, aumento del coste de numerosos servicios y alimentos, privatización de lo público y reducción de ayudas a los sectores más vulnerables: eso es lo que preocupa a la clase trabajadora argentina.


Y hay que decirlo sin medias tintas: Milei es un sionista confeso, que ha convertido su alineamiento con Israel en una de las señas centrales de su política exterior, dispuesto a subordinar la soberanía argentina a intereses extranjeros. No parece defender una política exterior basada prioritariamente en las necesidades de su pueblo, sino una alineación internacional muy concreta. Porque Milei, además de representar una determinada concepción neoliberal, actúa —a juicio de sus críticos— como un auténtico vendepatrias: su verdadera patria parece ser el dinero, venga de donde venga.


Pero la historia también enseña que el pueblo organizado termina despertando. La respuesta frente al salvajismo neoliberal debe ser la movilización, la solidaridad internacionalista y la lucha social para recuperar cada derecho que pretenden arrebatarnos. Milei puede gustar a quien no pasa hambre en Argentina o a quien conserva su empleo. Pero resulta mucho más difícil que convenza a quien no puede alimentar a sus hijos, a quien ha perdido su trabajo o a quien se siente estafado por un discurso contra la casta que terminó dirigiéndose contra buena parte de la …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Venezuela sin petróleo, sin soberanía, sin esperanza: así se cobra el imperio la osadía de un pueblo libre
content:
Camaradas:


De vez en cuando, en algún rincón del mundo, nace un hombre que ama de verdad a su pueblo. No un hombre que gobierna para los suyos ni que administra la miseria ajena desde un despacho, sino alguien capaz de mirar de frente a la geopolítica mundial y llamar al imperialismo por su nombre. En Venezuela, ese hombre se llamó Hugo Chávez. Denunció el genocidio en Gaza cuando denunciarlo no era tendencia en ninguna red social. Denunció cada agresión de las multinacionales, cada intervención colonialista de Washington, Bruselas o Tel Aviv, una y otra vez, sin ambages y sin miedo a las consecuencias.


Y cuando supo que su tiempo se acababa, Chávez también supo ver quién debía continuar. Acertó al confiar en Nicolás Maduro. Maduro ha demostrado, con hechos y no con palabras, que aquella confianza no fue un error: fue, de todos los que estaban en la cúpula de poder de la revolución bolivariana, el único que creyó hasta el final en lo que se estaba construyendo. Tuvo el valor de sostenerlo hasta que fue secuestrado por Estados Unidos.


Porque eso es lo que ocurrió, camaradas, y hay que decirlo sin eufemismos: el 3 de enero de 2026, tropas estadounidenses lanzaron ataques aéreos sobre Caracas y varios estados venezolanos, y Donald Trump anunció que Maduro y su esposa, Cilia Flores, habían sido capturados y trasladados fuera del país para enfrentarse a cargos de narcoterrorismo ante tribunales de Estados Unidos. Un secuestro de Estado, disfrazado de operación judicial, contra el presidente de una nación soberana.


Maduro jamás renunció al legado de Chávez. Eso lo engrandece como líder, como persona y como chavista, y la historia lo recordará por su honestidad y por no abandonar su puesto mientras tuvo margen para defenderlo.


Ocho meses después de aquel secuestro, la vicepresidenta Delcy Rodríguez gobierna Venezuela como presidenta interina, siguiendo al pie de la letra la hoja de ruta que Washington diseñó: estabilización, «recuperación económica» y transición vigilada. Y esta misma semana hemos conocido el resultado real de esa hoja de ruta: un acuerdo petrolero que el propio Trump ha calificado como «el mayor de la historia», mediante el cual Estados Unidos se ha asegurado el control mayoritario de más de 65.000 millones de barriles de las reservas venezolanas, con la participación de operadores privados en el desarrollo de diecisiete campos estratégicos.


Venezuela ya no es dueña de su petróleo. Venezuela ya no es dueña de su soberanía.


La economía no levanta cabeza, la inflación sigue golpeando, y eso le ocurre a todos los países donde interviene Estados Unidos. Cuando el imperio pasa por un país repartiendo «democracia», lo deja convertido en cementerio, en manicomio o en cadáver económico, atado para chuparle la sangre hasta la última gota. Y esa gota, en Venezuela, se llama petróleo.


Quieren llenar sus reservas estratégicas —que a principios de agosto habían caído por debajo de los 300 millones de barriles— y bajar el precio de la gasolina en su país robándole el crudo a Venezuela y estrangulando a su pueblo.


Que hablen ahora aquellos que hacían cola pidiendo que se llevaran a Maduro. Que hablen ahora los que deseaban la intervención de Estados Unidos, ahora que ya la tienen.


Es verdad que a algún privilegiado le puede ir bien, a muy pocos. Pero también es verdad que antes, bajo el bloqueo y las sanciones, Venezuela estaba mal porque había decidido luchar y defender su soberanía. Ahora está igual de mal o peor, pero sin soberanía, sin petróleo y sin capacidad para decidir nada sin permiso de Washington.


Antes, al menos, quedaba la esperanza de tener el destino en las propias manos. Ahora ni eso: los dueños de Venezuela son Estados Unidos, las grandes multinacionales y el sionismo internacional, ya no el pueblo venezolano ni su Gobierno.


Aunque algunos no lo quieran ver, este es un cambio descomunal, un cambio de era. Es la misma ausencia de esperanza que sufre el Congo, o tantos países de riquezas inmensas donde no hace falta sanción ni bloqueo alguno porque el pueblo ya está sometido a la miseria, con niños trabajando en minas y gente muriendo de hambre sin que a nadie le importe.


Venezuela ha entrado en esa categoría: la de los países cuyas riquezas energéticas interesan mucho y cuyos pueblos no le importan a nadie. Es un paso atrás, una involución tremenda y una traición manifiesta al legado de Hugo Chávez.


A mí esto me duele, camaradas, personalmente. Me duele Venezuela, me duele …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Una lectura del libro: El Rugir de las multitudes. La Bolivia de otro tiempo de Pablo Mamani Ramirez
content:
Una lectura del libro: El

Rugir de las multitudes. La Bolivia de otro tiempo

 de Pablo Mamani Ramirez  


El 29 de julio de 2026 se presentó el libro

Rugir de las multitudes. La Bolivia de otro tiempo

 (2026), del sociólogo aymara Pablo Mamani Ramírez, en el espacio Waliki. Posteriormente, el 1 de agosto, la obra fue presentada en la Feria Internacional del Libro de La Paz.


El libro “Rugir de las multitudes” es un aporte apasionante de leer, por el compromiso e involucramiento del autor con las luchas indias del Kollasuyu. Sin duda, busca explicar los movimientos sociales indios entre febrero, septiembre-octubre de 2000, junio y julio de 2001, y septiembre-octubre de 2003, desde una mirada crítica y microsociológica, basada en una metodología cualitativa con entrevistas, observación participante e historias de vida. La obra del profesor Pablo Mamani muestra un período histórico intenso y vivo de los actores sociales organizados en movimientos sociales aymaras y quechuas, que buscaban interpelar al Estado q’ara, cuestionar el orden republicano boliviano y, fundamentalmente, provocar un quiebre histórico y pulverizar el modelo neoliberal multicultural.


Un tema apasionante de estudio, tanto para la generación del profesor Pablo como para mi generación, han sido los movimientos sociales.


Los movimientos sociales son formas de acción colectiva que plantean demandas reivindicativas orientadas a reformas o cambios estructurales, mediante las cuales los grupos y organizaciones sociales presentan demandas públicas ante el Estado o buscan acceder al poder, utilizando diversos repertorios de movilización (García Linera, 2006; Tilly, 2000). Asimismo, la identidad cultural da sentido y cohesión a los movilizados, pues puede comprometer a miembros dispersos en una acción colectiva unificada (Mamani, 2026, p. 64).


En Bolivia se había inaugurado una escuela de la teoría de la acción colectiva (García Linera, Zabaleta, Prada y Tapia). Sin embargo, desde mi perspectiva, el sociólogo Pablo Mamani ha inaugurado una teoría de la acción colectiva identitaria desde una perspectiva indianista-katarista, apoyada en la escuela de movilización de recursos de Tilly (2000) y en el enfoque de la identidad de Alberto Melucci. Por ello, Mamani afirma:


“La identidad en los movimientos sociales tiene su particular importancia al igual que la movilización de recursos. La identidad es esa capacidad de definirse a sí mismos y definir a los otros. Y la movilización de recursos es un mecanismo estratégico de disponer recursos para lograr un determinado fin, mediado por la memoria y los lugares que la encarnan” (Mamani, 2026, p. 71).


Pérdida de la memoria colectiva larga y corta


El libro “Rugir de las multitudes” constituye un recordatorio de la memoria histórica larga y corta. Nos hace comprender el poder de la palabra escrita para las luchas sociales, los proyectos políticos, sus victorias, sus derrotas, sus errores, sus proyecciones y la lucha por la identidad y el poder. Es algo que, sin duda, no debemos olvidar: de dónde venimos y cuáles son nuestras luchas.


En el movimiento social de 2026, muchos han olvidado esas luchas sociales y a la generación de 2000, 2001 y 2003, una generación gloriosa. Muchos jóvenes, en la actualidad, olvidan su identidad y se creen

jailones

 alteños de las zonas céntricas de El Alto.


Esto me hace recordar la novela Cien años de soledad, de Gabriel García Márquez, particularmente el episodio de la peste del insomnio, donde los habitantes de Macondo dejan de dormir y comienzan a olvidar el nombre de las cosas y los objetos. Sin duda, si olvidamos y no aprendemos de nuestro pasado, estamos condenados a repetirlo. Por ello, debemos mantener viva la memoria larga y corta en las nuevas generaciones. Porque quienes hoy discriminan son, muchas veces, nuestros propios hijos e hijas morenos, que ya no se autoidentifican como aymaras, ni como hijos de migrantes de provincias.


Ya no somos El Alto de 2003, unido y movilizado como un solo cuerpo. Era un cuerpo unido porque el modelo neoliberal, junto con la pobreza y la crisis económica, nos cohesionaba frente a ese monstruo denominado modelo Nepliberal. Quya Reyna Suñagua (2022) tiene razón cuando escribe en su libro “Los hijos de Goni”:


“Papá vio esos restos e inmediatamente gritó: ¡Pero qué se creen ustedes para dejar sobrar la comida! ¿Se creen hijos de Goni? ¡Váyanse a vivir con Goni!” (p. 13).

title: 18 saat çalışma, yüzde 40 kesinti, Kod 49 ile fesih
content:
Bodrum’da Xuma Beach’te 18 saate varan çalışma, ödenmeyen fazla mesailer, bahşiş kesintileri ve 16 işçinin işten çıkarılmasıyla gündeme gelen mücadele, turizm sezonunda işçilerin karşı karşıya kaldığı çalışma koşullarını hatırlattı. Bodrum’da farklı otellerde çalışan işçilerin anlatımları; uzun çalışma saatleri, personel eksikliği, iş tanımının dışında da işler yaptırılması, mola ve beslenme sorunları, lojman koşulları, örgütsüzlük ve hak arayan işçilerin güvencesizliğinin sektör genelinde ortaklaştığını gösteriyor.

Turizm sektöründe sezon, patronlar açısından yoğunluğun ve müşteri trafiğinin arttığı dönem anlamına gelirken, işçiler açısından daha uzun çalışma saatleri ve artan iş yükü anlamına geliyor. Bodrum’da Xuma Beach’te çalışan işçilerin yaşadıkları da bu tablonun somut örneklerinden biri oldu.

İstanbul’dan sezonluk çalışmak için Bodrum’a gelen Xuma Beach çalışanı Melek Acar işe başlarken 9 saatlik vardiya sözü verilse de fiili sürelerin yoğun günlerde bunun çok üzerine çıktığını anlattı. Acar, Kenan Doğulu konseri günü sabah başlayan mesainin temizlikle birlikte gece 03.00’te bittiğini ve çalışma süresinin 18 saati bulduğunu belirtti.

Uzun mesailer yalnızca etkinlik günleriyle sınırlı değil. Bodrum’da çalışan bir otel çalışanı, vardiyalar arasına konulan 2-3 saatlik “split” (bölünmüş) bekleme süreleri nedeniyle günün tamamının otelde geçtiğini aktardı. Dışarı çıkamayan ve otel içinde dinlenmeye çalışan işçiler için kağıt üzerindeki molalar fiilen çalışma gününü uzatan bir faktöre dönüşüyor.

Otel işçileri fazla mesai ücretleri konusunda sistematik sorunlar yaşıyor. Giriş-çıkışlar kartla takip edilmesine rağmen yöneticilerin sisteme onay vermemesi gerekçesiyle mesailer eksik kaydediliyor. Otel işçisi 300 günlük fazla mesaisi olan arkadaşına 100 gün yazıldığını ve bunun da yasal 1.5 katsayısı yerine birebir oranla ödendiğini ifade etti.

Xuma Beach'te kredi kartıyla verilen bahşişlerden yüzde 40 kesinti yapılması ve gerekçesinin açıklanmaması tepkilere yol açtı. İşçilerin hak arayışı üzerine yayımlanan son bordrolara cüzi miktarda mesai yansıtılsa da bu ödemeler geçmiş dönemdeki uzun çalışmaları karşılamadı.

Personel eksikliğini gidermeyen işletmeler, çalışanları kendi alanları dışındaki işlere yönlendiriyor. Garson olarak işe başlayanlar; açılış öncesi boya, taşıma ve temizlik gibi işlerin yanı sıra sezon içinde bulaşıkhane ve komilik gibi görevleri üstlenmek zorunda kalıyor. Eksik ekipman (çatal, tabak, tirbuşon) nedeniyle müşterilerle karşı karşıya gelen çalışanlar, işletme kaynaklı sorunların faturasını ödeyerek hakaret ve mobbinge maruz kalıyor. Bodrum’da çalışan otel işçisi “Çok fazla eleman eksikliği var. İşçiden, personelden kısıyorlar. Bir yerde sıkıntı varsa başka bir yerden bir insan alıp oraya getiriyor ve sürekli çalıştırıyorlar. İşçinin iliğini kemiğini sömürüyorlar” diyor.

Yoğun tempoda verilen yarım saatlik yemek molaları dinlenmeye yetmiyor. Mutfak imkanı bulunmayan lojmanlarda kalan çalışanlar, otelin sunduğu yetersiz yemeklere bağımlı duruma geliyor. Xuma Beach’te personelin ana mutfaktan yemek yiyebilmesi için ek ücret ödemesi gerekiyor.

Şehirden uzak lojmanlar nedeniyle gidiş-dönüş yolculuğu 2 saati buluyor; son servise kalan çalışanların dönüşü gece 01.30’u geçebiliyor. Hijyen malzemesi eksikliği ve bakımsız çamaşır makineleri gibi olumsuzluklar, uykusuzluk ve sosyal izolasyonla birleşerek çalışanlar arasında gerilime yol açıyor. İşletmeler ise bu gerilimlerin nedenini çözmek yerine kavga eden işçileri işten çıkarıyor.

Sektördeki ucuz iş gücü politikalarının en ağır yükünü MESEM’li öğrenciler çekiyor. Okullarla yapılan anlaşmalarla tesislere getirilen stajyerler, 17-18 bin lira gibi düşük ücretlerle en ağır işlerde çalıştırılıyor. Stajlarının yakılması tehdidiyle baskı altında tutulan gençlere, mobbing uygulanıyor ve çocuk işçi olmalarına rağmen zorla fazla mesai yaptırılıyor.

Taleplerine yanıt alamayan Xuma Beach işçileri, çalışmaktan kaçınma haklarını kullandı. Formayla çalışma alanına inen işçilerin karşısına muhatap yerine polis çıkarıldı. Aralarında bir stajyerin de bulunduğu 16 işçi, SGK Kod 49 (Ahlak ve iyi niyet kurallarına aykırılık) iddiasıyla tazminatsız şekilde işten çıkarıldı. Kıdem ve ihbar tazminatı ödenmeyen işçiler fesih kodunun düzeltilmesini, ihbar ve diğer alacaklarının ödenmesini, geçmişe dönük fazla mesailerinin hesaplanmasını talep ediyor. Stajyer çalışanın stajının onaylanmaması da işçilerin gündeme getirdiği başlıklardan biri.

Tüm Otel ve Turizm İşçileri …

Acaba var mıdır? 


Geçmiş zaman… 31 Aralık 2008 tarihli 27097 sayılı Resmî Gazetenin 5. Mükerrer sayılı nüshasında “Bakanlar Kurulu” kararı yayımlanmıştı.

(2008/14481 sayılı karar) 


O tarihlerde Bakanlar Kurulu vardı. Parlamento tarihinden silindi artık hiç yok!


2008 yılında Abdullah Gül Cumhurbaşkanı, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Başbakan sıfatıyla Bakanlar Kurulunun bu kararına Bakanlarla birlikte imza atmışlar.  Bakanlar Kurulu’nun aldığı

“Avrupa Birliği Müktesebatının Üstlenilmesine İlişkin Türkiye Ulusal Programının Uygulanması, Koordinasyonu ve  İzlenmesine Dair Karar”

Genel İlkeler

Avrupa Birliği Müktesebatının Üstlenilmesine İlişkin Türkiye Ulusal Programı


(Ulusal Program),

 Türkiye’nin Avrupa Birliğine katılım sürecinde, kısa ve orta vadede gerçekleştirilmesi öngörülen çalışmaları kapsamaktaydı. Bu alanda yapılacak çalışmaların temel esas ve unsurları Ulusal Program’da belirlenerek “

tüm kamu kurum ve kuruluşlarının, gerekli çalışmaları Ulusal Programda yer alan hedefler doğrultusunda ve belirlenen zamanda gerçekleştirmeleri esas”

 kabul edilmişti. 


Zaman geldi geçti… Bu Karar hükümlerini Bakanlar Kurulu yürütecekti. Bakanlar Kurulu kaldırılmış olduğuna göre yürütülecek bir karar da kalmamış oldu. 


Ulusal Programın

“Siyasi Kriterleri”

 içeriğinde Türkiye’nin kapsamlı anayasal ve yasal reformlar gerçekleştirmiş olduğundan bahsediliyor ve bu hedeflerin uygulamaya geçirilmesi için süratle gereken adımların atıldığı yazılmıştı.  


Siyasi Kriterlerde

 şöyle denilmişti: 


“Bu bağlamda, işkence ve kötü muamelenin önlenmesine yönelik kapsamlı yasal ve idari düzenlemeler yapılmış ve “sıfır

hoşgörü

Ölüm cezası her koşulda kaldırılmıştır. “Avrupa İnsan Hakları Sözleşmesi” (AİHS) hükümleri ile “Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesi” (AİHM) içtihadı ile uyumlu olarak düşünce, ifade ve basın özgürlükleri genişletilmiştir. Kadın-erkek eşitliğinin geliştirilmesi ile kadın ve çocuğa yönelik şiddetle etkin mücadele edilmesine ilişkin düzenlemeler yapılmıştır. Bütün Türk vatandaşlarının kültürel zenginlik ve hakları güvence altına alınmış, Türk vatandaşlarının günlük hayatlarında geleneksel olarak kullandıkları farklı dil ve lehçelerde öğrenim ve yayın hakkı sağlanmıştır.”

author: DebConf 26
title: Age verification is moving into the OS layer: Can open source still shape the standards?
content:
by Douglimar Moraes


by Matheus Polkorny


At: DebConf26


https://debconf26.debconf.org/talks/101-age-verification-is-moving-into-the-os-layer-can-open-source-still-shape-the-standards/


Age verification and digital identity systems are increasingly being pushed into operating system-level APIs. This talk presents the Brazilian “ECA Digital” consultation as a case study of how these requirements are being translated into technical infrastructure while still under active definition, with ongoing exploration involving a public research institution (IPT) and industry actors such as Lenovo.


We focus strictly on the technical dimension of emerging systems design, avoiding legal or policy discussion. The goal is to analyze implications for open source systems, particularly interoperability, privacy, and the risk of proprietary implementations becoming de facto standards.

title: Duran Kalkan: The Zoğurlu family left its mark on the history of the struggle
content:
A commemoration was held in the German city of Bergisch Gladbach for Seyfettin Zoğurlu, one of the PKK’s leading cadres, and 19 members of the Zoğurlu family who were killed at different times.


The hall where the commemoration was held was decorated with photographs of Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan and PKK leading cadres who had been killed. The stage was decorated with photographs of Seyfettin Zoğurlu and other fallen members of the Zoğurlu family.


Duran Kalkan's video message


A video message sent by Dursun Kalkan, a member of the Abdullah Öcalan Academy of Social Sciences, was also shown during the program. Kalkan spoke about Seyfettin Zoğurlu and the fallen members of the Zoğurlu family.


Duran Kalkan’s message was as follows:


“I commemorate with respect, love, and gratitude our comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu, one of the founders of our party, a great revolutionary and our patriotic comrade, on the 40th anniversary of his martyrdom. I renew my promise to fulfill his purpose and keep his memory alive. In the person of comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu, I respectfully salute everyone attending the commemoration ceremony for the martyrs of the Zoğurlu family.


Indeed, Leader Apo created an army of martyrs. And now, as the Movement and as a people, we are walking under the leadership of Leader Apo and the Army of Martyrs. So much so that, with the exception of a handful of collaborator traitors, every family has become a family of martyrs. Every day is a day of martyrs for us. Every day, on each of the 365 days of the year, we have dozens of great martyrs. Of course, the Zoğurlu family holds an important place among them. For one thing, comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu participated in our party’s founding congress, was involved from its establishment onward, and always fought on the front lines. A great revolutionary, a profound patriot, a great fighter. Indeed, he was one of those who most effectively implemented and carried forward the line of Ali Haydar Kaytan. I personally witnessed this. His brother, comrade Alaattin Zoğurlu, was also a comrade who played a role and carried out duties at our party’s founding congress.


The Zoğurlu will always be remembered


The Zoğurlu family hosted the founding of the PKK. They played a role in preparing, conducting, and successfully carrying out the founding congress. Everyone contributed. We knew comrade Seyfettin’s mother, father, and children closely. All of them served this struggle. They joined the struggle, particularly comrade Ferzende. They participated in the struggle at different levels and were killed. They created a great force of martyrs. The Zoğurlu family became a family of martyrs. They have already secured a distinct place in the history of our freedom struggle. We believe that this place will always endure.


The Zoğurlu family will always be remembered as having a valuable and honorable place in the history of the Kurdistan freedom struggle.


I knew comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu from 1977 onward. I met comrade Alaattin after he deserted from the military. I also knew Ferzende and many other members of the family. We worked together. They were all deeply patriotic, committed, self-sacrificing, and courageous people. Comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu was a thoroughly patriotic personality. He was a fighter. His anger and opposition toward the enemy were very strong. He had lost his grandfather as a martyr in the struggle. He was deeply angry about the situation of the Kurdish people and Kurdistan. He joined the struggle on this basis and fought.


On November 27, 1978, he participated as a delegate in the PKK’s founding congress, which was held at his own home. He was the Amed delegate. He later took part in civil resistance. He helped lay the foundations of the struggle in Amed. Comrade Seyfettin Zoğurlu is the comrade who laid the foundations of the patriotism and resistance that have developed in Amed today and who contributed the most to this effort.


He went to the Lebanon-Palestine area twice, going abroad. The first time, he saw the situation and returned.


After the September 1980 coup, he went again to the Lebanon-Palestine area as part of the general withdrawal. He lived and struggled alongside the Palestinian people. During the Nebatiye resistance, when Israel launched its attack on Lebanon in June 1982, he was one of the leading militants of the resistance. He was captured by Israel and remained in captivity for years. While he was being taken from Greece to …

author: Unknown
title: Ferry carrying 267 people capsizes off Cyprus: 7 dead, 23 missing
content:
A ferry carrying 267 people - 259 passengers and 8 crew members- capsized off the coast of Cyprus on Sunday morning after departing for the Taşucu Port in Mersin from Kyrenia Port in Northern Cyprus. Local authorities reported that the catamaran-style ferry had begun taking on water, and according to latest reports, at least seven people were killed.


Authorities said that 237 people had been rescued. Search and rescue operations at sea are continuing as 23 other people are reported missing.


Erhan Arıklı, Northern Cyprus’s Minister of Public Works and Transport, said that the rescued passengers were brought to Kyrenia Port for medical treatment. The cause of the accident remains unknown.


The ferry was reported to have departed from Kyrenia Port shortly before the accident. Footage broadcast on Turkish television showed the ferry being tossed about in rough seas and partially submerged despite otherwise favorable weather conditions.


Footage of the rescue shows passengers being evacuated wearing life jackets, as well as debris floating on the surface of the sea and numerous ambulances and helicopters waiting on shore.


The ferry accident occurred following severe weather conditions that have affected the Eastern Mediterranean in recent days.


Strong winds and heavy rainfall have been reported across the region, with weather conditions particularly affecting transportation and maritime traffic along the coasts of Cyprus and Lebanon.


Northern Cyprus’s Ministry of Health said that all necessary measures had been taken at ports and at public and private hospitals, and that medical teams had been placed on standby to respond.


The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus is internationally recognized only by Turkey. The northern part of the island came under Turkish occupation following Turkey’s 1974 military intervention in Cyprus, and Northern Cyprus unilaterally declared independence in 1983.

title: Tülay Hatimoğulları: We will embark on a brand-new process of building
content:
The Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) Co-Chair Tülay Hatimoğulları addressed a public gathering at the Tepekule Congress Center in İzmir province.


Thousands of people attended the gathering, where a banner reading “A Free and Organized Society for a Democratic Republic” was displayed.


One of the steps toward the democratization of society is through peace


Tülay Hatimoğulları stated that building a democratic society is possible through a society organized on democratic foundations, adding, “We all know very well that one of the steps toward the democratization of society is through peace.”


The DEM Party Co-Chair continued:


“For 50 years, war and conflict have continued across Turkey. Over the course of those 50 years, we have collectively witnessed immense suffering. Despite all this pain and all these losses, the Kurdish people—especially mothers—have never stopped calling for peace. Such words can only be spoken by people who, over 50 years, have developed a deep awareness and ideological consciousness, who understand and give meaning to the sacrifices that have been made, who recognize the importance of peace, and who have raised this understanding to the highest level of consciousness. In this way, they expressed the feelings and thoughts of the peoples there who have paid a heavy price.


May the mothers of both soldiers and guerrillas rest assured: until not a single gunshot is heard in these lands, until we reach a point where not even a single tear is shed, we will stand by this process to the very end. We will continue to call for an honorable peace.”


Hatimoğulları pointed out that they took into consideration the criticism regarding the process, stating:


“On February 27, 2025, Mr. Abdullah Öcalan made a very important call from İmralı: the Call for Peace and Democratic Society. This process is approaching its second year. And throughout these nearly two years, we have encountered tremendous difficulties and major obstacles, overcoming them one by one to reach where we are today.


Regarding the criticisms and assessments of the process, we have friends who have offered sincere, friendly, heartfelt, and constructive criticism. I would once again like to state that we take these criticisms into account and consider them important.


However, we should all be certain of this: as you can imagine, the implementation of this process is necessarily carried out with the existing executive authority. Therefore, as Mr. Öcalan has also stated, this process cannot be narrowly reduced to electoral calculations. Nor can it be viewed narrowly through the interests of any political party.


If a concrete step can be taken in this process toward resolving the century-old Kurdish question, we should recognize that it is the talks with the state and the negotiations conducted with the government, as the executive authority, that have brought the process to this point.”


Peace and democracy are an inseparable path


Drawing attention to developments in the Middle East, Tülay Hatimoğulları said, “At a time when we are witnessing the emergence of a new regional alignment, particularly involving Israel, and as the crisis of global capital that began in 2008 and the crisis of capitalism play out through regional power struggles, with imperialist powers seeking to reshape the Middle East, solidarity among peoples has, of course, become far more urgent and essential.”


Tülay Hatimoğulları continued:


“If this process has begun today, we should recognize that developments in the region played a very significant role in its initiation. We believe that the analyses concerning these developments need to be reconsidered. Some of those involved appear to support peace, but in essence they actually thrive on war, violence, and conflict. We see systematic attacks against this process being carried out through social media.


We welcome all friendly and constructive criticism. But in the face of racist attacks, rhetoric inciting war, and those who pretend to support one thing while actually doing something entirely different, we will continue to defend peace. Because the way to make peace and democracy an inseparable path is for all of us to embrace this process more strongly together.

title: İETT otobüsü kazasında ağır yaralanmıştı: 39 yaşındaki Fatma Hacer Eroğlu hayatını kaybetti
content:
İstanbul Zeytinburnu’nda İETT otobüsünün bir sitenin bahçe duvarına çarpması sonucu meydana gelen kazada ağır yaralanan 39 yaşındaki Fatma Hacer Eroğlu, tedavi gördüğü hastanede hayatını kaybetti. Kazada yaşamını yitirenlerin sayısı 3’e yükseldi.

Kaza, 28 Ağustos günü saat 17.00 sıralarında Kennedy Caddesi’nde meydana geldi. Bakırköy istikametine seyreden İETT otobüsü, sürücüsü A.G.’nin direksiyon hakimiyetini kaybetmesi sonucu bir sitenin bahçe duvarına çarptı.

İhbar üzerine olay yerine itfaiye, polis ve sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Kazada 2 kişinin olay yerinde hayatını kaybettiği, 19 kişinin ise yaralandığı belirlendi.

Kazada ağır yaralanan yolculardan Fatma Hacer Eroğlu, sağlık ekiplerinin ilk müdahalesinin ardından ambulansla hastaneye kaldırıldı.

Tedavi altına alınan Eroğlu, kazadan iki gün sonra, 30 Ağustos’ta hayatını kaybetti.

Eroğlu’nun ölümüyle birlikte kazada hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 3’e yükseldi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Girne açıklarında batan gemiye ilişkin 8 kişi gözaltına alındı
content:
KKTC Başbakanı Ünal Üstel, Girne açıklarında alabora olan yolcu gemisine ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada gemi kaptanı ve 7 görevlinin gözaltına alındığını açıkladı.

Mersin'e giden feribot Girne açıklarında battı: 7 kişi yaşamını yitirdi, 23 kişi kayıp

KKTC Başbakanı Ünal Üstel, Girne kenti açıklarında alabora olan yolcu gemisine ilişkin yazılı açıklama yaptı.

Üstel, söz konusu olaya ilişkin gemi kaptanı ve 7 görevlinin gözaltına alındığını duyurdu.

"Bu olayın her yönü araştırılacak" diyen Üstel, "En küçük bir ihmal dahi varsa ortaya çıkarılacak. Kusuru ve sorumluluğu bulunan kim olursa olsun gözünün yaşına bakılmayacaktır" ifadelerini kullandı.

Üstel'in açıklaması şu şekilde:

"Kıbrıs’ın yaşadığı en büyük deniz felaketi olarak tarihe geçen elim bir kazayla karşı karşıyayız. Acımız çok büyük. Kaybettiğimiz insanlarımıza Allah’tan rahmet, ailelerine ve yakınlarına sabır ve başsağlığı, yaralılarımıza acil şifalar diliyorum.

Kazanın meydana geldiği ilk andan itibaren devletimizin bütün imkânları seferber edilmiştir. İlk müdahalede 4 Sahil Güvenlik botu, 2 helikopter, Türk Barış Kuvvetlerine ait 1 karakol gemisi, 1 hücum botu ile Sivil Savunma ve Polis Teşkilatımıza bağlı dalgıç ekipleri ve beraberindeki 4 arama kurtarma botu çalışmalara katılmıştır.

Arama kurtarma kapasitesi süreç içerisinde daha da güçlendirilmiştir. Halen bölgede Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri tarafından görevlendirilen 2 uçak, 4 helikopter, 4 İHA ve 4 Sahil Güvenlik botu arama kurtarma çalışmalarına aktif olarak katılmaktadır.

KTBK Komutanlığı, GKK Komutanlığı, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetlerinden gönderilen unsurlar, T.C. İçişleri Bakanlığı Sahil Güvenlik Komutanlığı, Polis Teşkilatımız ve Sivil Savunma Teşkilat Başkanlığımız büyük bir koordinasyon içerisinde çalışmalarını aralıksız sürdürmektedir.

Kısa bir süre içerisinde Deniz Kuvvetlerine bağlı, 1000 metre derinliğe kadar arama yapabilecek ve gemi batığına ulaşabilecek kapasiteye sahip arama kurtarma gemisi de KKTC’ye ulaşarak çalışmalara dahil olacaktır.

Havadan, denizden ve denizin altından bütün imkanlarımızla arıyoruz. Tek bir imkanımızı dahi kullanmadan bırakmayacağız. Kayıplarımıza ulaşana kadar arama kurtarma çalışmalarımız aralıksız devam edecektir.

Türkiye Cumhurbaşkanı Sayın Recep Tayyip Erdoğan da şahsımı arayarak yaşanan büyük felaket nedeniyle üzüntülerini dile getirmiş; şahsıma ve halkımıza başsağlığı dileklerini iletmiş, Türkiye Cumhuriyeti’nin ihtiyaç duyulan her alanda sınırsız destek vermeye hazır olduğunu ifade etmiştir.

Türkiye Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Sayın Cevdet Yılmaz ise kazanın yaşandığı ilk andan itibaren bizlerle sürekli istişare içerisinde olmuş ve süreci yakından takip etmektedir.

Milliyetçi Hareket Partisi Genel Başkanı Sayın Devlet Bahçeli de şahsımı arayarak yaşanan büyük felaket nedeniyle duyduğu derin üzüntüyü ve başsağlığı dileklerini iletmiş, bu zor günde Kıbrıs Türk halkının yanında olduklarını ifade etmiştir.

Bu büyük acımızda ilk andan itibaren yanımızda olan Türkiye Cumhuriyeti’ne, Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Hükümeti’ne, Sayın Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’a, Sayın Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz’a ve dayanışmalarını ifade eden MHP Genel Başkanı Sayın Devlet Bahçeli’ye Kıbrıs Türk halkı adına teşekkür ediyorum.

Bir yandan arama kurtarma çalışmalarımız sürerken, diğer yandan bu felaketin nasıl meydana geldiğinin ortaya çıkarılması için soruşturma derhal başlatılmıştır. Gemi kaptanı ve 7 görevli gözaltına alınmıştır.

Buradan çok net söylüyorum: Bu olayın her yönü araştırılacak. En küçük bir ihmal dahi varsa ortaya çıkarılacak. Kusuru ve sorumluluğu bulunan kim olursa olsun gözünün yaşına bakılmayacaktır. Bu büyük felaketin bütün boyutlarıyla aydınlatılması, devletimizin hem görevi hem de kaybettiğimiz insanlarımıza ve ailelerine karşı sorumluluğudur.

Bugün acımız büyüktür. Ancak devletimiz bütün kurumlarıyla görevinin başındadır. Şimdi bütün gücümüzle kayıplarımıza ulaşmaya, yaralarımızı sarmaya ve bu büyük felaketin bütün gerçeklerini ortaya çıkarmaya odaklanmış durumdayız. Kaybettiğimiz insanlarımıza bir kez daha Allah’tan rahmet, ailelerine ve yakınlarına sabır, yaralılarımıza acil şifalar diliyorum. Dualarımız, aradığımız insanlarımıza bir an önce ulaşılması içindir."

Kuzey Kıbrıs'ın Girne kenti açıklarında 267 yolcu ve mürettebatın bulunduğu yolcu gemisi bugün öğle saatlerinde alabora oldu.

Olayın ardından bölgede arama kurtarma çalışması başlatıldı. Kazada şu ana kadar 8 kişi hayatını kaybederken 17 kişiden ise henüz haber alınamadı.

author: infolibre
title: Σε ενέργειες κατά της οικοδόμησης του Χαρασώνα προβαίνει το Παρατηρητήριο Ποιότητας Περιβάλλοντος Σύρου
content:
Οι προσφυγές του Παρατηρητηρίου για την οικοδόμηση του Χαρασώνα στο Διοικητικό Εφετείο Πειραιά και στο ΣτΕ


Στον Χαρασώνα της Σύρου βρίσκεται σε εξέλιξη ένα κολοσσιαίο σχέδιο οικοδόμησης. Έχουν χτιστεί ήδη αρκετές βίλλες, άλλες τόσες χτίζονται τώρα, ενώ προγραμματίζονται πολύ πολύ περισσότερες. Μια τεράστια έκταση θα γεμίσει με βίλλες και πισίνες ενώ στην είσοδό της θα υπάρχει μια πύλη για την πρόσβαση των «τυχερών» στην μέχρι πρότινος παρθένα περιοχή.


Το Παρατηρητήριο έχει προσφύγει στο Διοικητικό Εφετείο Πειραιά για την ακύρωση των οικοδομικών αδειών που έχουν εκδοθεί για την περιοχή του Χαρασώνα από την ΥΔΟΜ Σύρου Ερμούπολης, καθώς και την αναστολή των εργασιών μέχρι τη λήψη της οριστικής απόφασης, προβάλλοντας συγκεκριμένα νομικά επιχειρήματα πολεοδομικής και περιβαλλοντικής φύσης σύμφωνα με τα οποία, κατά την άποψή μας, δεν θα έπρεπε να είχαν εκδοθεί οικοδομικές άδειες στην περιοχή.


Επιπλέον, το Παρατηρητήριο έχει προσφύγει στο Συμβούλιο της Επικράτειας (ΣτΕ) για την ακύρωση του συνολικού σχεδίου οικοδόμησης του Χαρασώνα με αντίστοιχη επιχειρηματολογία.


Η αίτηση αναστολής θα συζητηθεί στο Διοικητικό Εφετείο Πειραιά την Τρίτη 1 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026 (7 μήνες μετά την κατάθεση της αίτησης).


Η αίτηση ακύρωσης των οικοδομικών αδειών της ΥΔΟΜ Σύρου Ερμούπολης θα συζητηθεί στο Διοικητικό Εφετείο Πειραιά στις 20 Οκτωβρίου 2026.


Η αίτηση ακύρωσης του συνολικού σχεδίου θα συζητηθεί στο ΣτΕ στις 7 Οκτωβρίου 2026.


Η μαζική τσιμεντοποίηση των νησιών για λόγους Real Estate θα μπορούσε να χαρακτηριστεί ως σύγχρονο El Dorado. Καταναλώνεται με εκθετικούς ρυθμούς το περιβαλλοντικό κεφάλαιο των νησιών το οποίο μετατρέπεται σε βίλλες, πισίνες και κέρδος. Όλο και λιγότερες είναι οι περιοχές των νησιών που παραμένουν αναλλοίωτες. Αυτές τις περιοχές οφείλουμε να τις προστατεύσουμε, να τις περισώσουμε από κερδοσκοπικές επελάσεις και να τις παραδώσουμε στις επόμενες γενιές.


Είναι ανατριχιαστική η σκέψη ότι ολόκληρα τα νησιά μπορεί, πολύ εύκολα, σε λίγα χρόνια να είναι χτισμένα απ΄ άκρη σ΄ άκρη και μάλιστα όχι για να εξυπηρετηθούν οικιστικές ανάγκες των κατοίκων τους. Αυτό το σενάριο γίνεται ολοένα και πιο ορατό. Η νομοθεσία –και πολλές φορές η ερμηνεία της- είναι κομμένη και ραμμένη ούτως ώστε να μην προστατεύει ουσιαστικά το περιβάλλον. Αντίθετα μπορεί να επιδοτεί και την καταστροφή του στο όνομα μιας απολύτως στρεβλής ανάπτυξης.


Αν ένα τέτοιο μέλλον το βρίσκετε αποκρουστικό, τώρα είναι η ώρα της –έστω και καθυστερημένης- αντίδρασης.


Αύριο σίγουρα θα είναι αργά.


30.08.2026


Παρατηρητήριο Ποιότητας Περιβάλλοντος Σύρου

author: Unknown
title: Antep Emek Gençliği: “Mahmut Soner Yazğan’ın ölümü kader değil, iş cinayetidir”
content:
Antep Emek Gençliği , Gaziantep 3. Organize Sanayi Bölgesi’nde bulunan Toprakçı İplik Fabrikası’nın çatısında çalışırken elektrik akımına kapılarak hayatını kaybeden 18 yaşındaki Mahmut Soner Yazğan’ın ölümüne ilişkin açıklama yaptı. Örgüt, Yazğan’ın ölümünün “iş kazası değil, iş cinayeti” olduğunu belirterek iş güvenliği önlemlerinin alınmamasına ve denetimlerin yetersizliğine tepki gösterdi.

Gençlik Örgütü tarafından yapılan açıklamada, “18 yaşındaki genç arkadaşımız Mahmut Soner Yazğan, Gaziantep 3. OSB’de bulunan Toprakçı İplik Fabrikası’nın çatısında çalışırken elektrik akımına kapılarak hayatını kaybetti” denildi.

Yazğan’ın ölümünün patronların daha fazla kâr elde etme amacıyla iş güvenliği önlemlerini geri plana attığı bir çalışma düzeninin sonucu olduğu ifade edilen açıklamada, “Mahmut Soner’in yaşamı; patronların daha fazla kâr uğruna iş güvenliğini hiçe saydığı, denetimlerin göstermelik kaldığı, işçilerin ise güvencesizliğe, düşük ücretlere ve ölümcül çalışma koşullarına mahkûm edildiği bu düzen tarafından elinden alındı. Bu bir kaza değil, iş cinayetidir” ifadelerine yer verildi.

Gaziantep’teki fabrikalarda işçilerin her gün ölüm ve yaralanma riskiyle çalışmak zorunda bırakıldığına dikkat çekilen açıklamada, alınmayan iş güvenliği önlemleri, yetersiz denetimler ve kâr hırsının işçilerin yaşamını tehdit ettiği belirtildi.

Açıklamada, göçmen işçilerin ve çocukların da güvencesiz çalışma koşullarına itildiği ifade edilerek, “Daha çocuk yaşta çalışmak zorunda bırakılan çocukların ve gençlerin emeği ucuz iş gücü olarak sömürülüyor” denildi.

Emek Gençliği, açıklamasında Mesleki Eğitim Merkezleri (MESEM) uygulamasına da tepki gösterdi. Açıklamada, “MESEM’lerle çocuk işçiliği eğitim adı altında meşrulaştırılıyor; çocuklar ve gençler sermayenin ucuz iş gücü deposuna dönüştürülüyor” ifadeleri kullanıldı.

Okul sıralarında olması gereken gençlerin fabrikalarda güvencesiz ve ölümcül koşullarda çalıştırıldığı belirtilen açıklamada, iş güvenliği önlemlerini almakla yükümlü olan işverenlerin sorumluluklarını yerine getirmesi gerektiği vurgulandı.

Açıklamada, gençlere ve emekçilere yoksulluk, borç, düşük ücret, işsizlik ve güvencesizliğin dayatıldığı belirtilerek mevcut çalışma düzenine karşı çıkıldı.

“Bize yıllardır aynı şey söyleniyor: Daha çok çalışın, daha azına razı olun, susun, bekleyin” denilen açıklamada, “Biz bu düzene mecbur değiliz” ifadeleri kullanıldı.

Antep Emek Gençliği, insanca yaşam ve çalışma koşulları talebini yineleyerek, “İş cinayetleri, yoksulluk, güvencesizlik, çocuk işçilik kader değildir. Geleceksizlik kader değildir!” dedi.

Açıklamanın sonunda Mahmut Soner Yazğan’ın unutulmayacağı vurgulanarak, “İş cinayetlerinde öldürülen MESEM’lileri, genç işçileri unutmayacağız, unutturmayacağız!” denildi.

Emek Gençliği, tüm gençleri ve emekçileri iş cinayetlerine, çocuk işçiliğine ve güvencesiz çalışma düzenine karşı örgütlenmeye ve mücadeleyi büyütmeye çağırdı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: DebConf 26
title: The Jupy Project: Bringing Native South American languages to GNU/Linux
content:
by Douglimar Moraes


by Rodnei Cilto


by Rodrigo Dias


At: DebConf26


https://debconf26.debconf.org/talks/86-the-jupy-project-bringing-native-south-american-languages-to-gnulinux/


Debian prides itself on being the "Universal Operating System", but modern technology still imposes Portuguese or Spanish as a prerequisite for using computers in South America. This linguistic barrier accelerates the cultural erasure and silencing of diverse communities. We believe free software is the only ecosystem capable of reversing this scenario, promoting true technological sovereignty and linguistic preservation.


In this talk, we present the initial stages of the Jupy Project, which aims to implement native support for Native South American languages like Kaingang, Nheengatu, Guarani, and Ticuna in Linux. Using the Lux Lenovo OS (a Debian-based distro) as a practical laboratory, we will share technical localization obstacles, such as creating glibc locales, keyboard mapping, and font rendering.


Our goal is to open a transparent dialogue about our main challenges: ensuring continuous maintenance and respectfully validating interfaces with the speaking communities. We invite the global Debian community to help us build architectural solutions and upstream contribution workflows that make Linux genuinely accessible to native  languages.

I will present what Debian Day is, Its importance to the Debian community, and why the event should take place in various cities around the world. author: DebConf 26
title: SBOM in Debian and sbom-toolkit
content:
by Walter Lozano


At: DebConf26


https://debconf26.debconf.org/talks/57-sbom-in-debian-and-sbom-toolkit/


Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) have become an increasingly important topic, especially in the embedded systems domain, where products must comply with different regulatory and market requirements depending on their target regions.


This trend has intensified in recent years, particularly with the


introduction of the


Cyber Resilience Act

,


which places greater responsibilities on product manufacturers regarding


the security and transparency of the software included in their products.


In this context, providing accurate and complete information about the


software running on a system is essential for several reasons:


Licensing and copyright: Software is subject to licensing obligations and


copyright regulations. Manufacturers must be able to identify the licenses


that apply to the software components they distribute, as well as the


corresponding copyright holders.


Security: New vulnerabilities are discovered every day. Accurately


identifying the exact versions of software components used in a product is


critical to assessing exposure to known vulnerabilities and understanding


potential security risks.


An SBOM provides the structured information required to address these


concerns by listing the software components included in a system along with


relevant metadata such as versions, licenses, and dependencies.


In this context, Debian already provides tooling to generate SBOMs, in


particular

sbom toolkit


which provides a debhelper add-on and scripts to help developers to prepare


such reports.

author: Novara Media
title: Multiculturalism Will Save the Working Class
content:
We live in a moment when the working class is fractured along a great many lines. Gone are the days of solidarity built around a shared experience of factory work that formed the bedrock of Karl Marx’s analysis of class struggle – and his vision of emancipation. Meanwhile in the halls of power, elites in our politics have failed for decades now to really grasp what people in Britain care about and need – resorting to lame stand-ins such as ‘Mondeo man’ and ‘Stevenage woman’, Farage’s new favourite: ‘alarm clock Britain’.


What are they missing? Lived experience, apart from anything else. On Downstream this week, Ash Sarkar sat down with campaigner and author Jonas Patrick Marvin to discuss his new book ‘The Breaking of the English Working Class’. Weaving autobiographical detail with political theory, Marvin tackles head-on the class forces that have shaped his own life.


Why can’t people born in London afford to stay and build lives there? Who gets to define themselves as working class, and on what grounds? How should the left respond to rising anti-immigration politics? Why has the working class become so fragmented, and what can be done to repair it?


Jonas’ book is available from Verso here: https://www.versobooks.com/en-gb/products/3145-the-breaking-of-the-english-working-class
